extras: Powered by safi-image; automatically applies EXIF orientation on open; does not decode AVIF, HEIC, progressive JPEG, animated GIF, or multi-page TIFF.
intentEvidence: This is the Obsidian port of the VS Code extension.
problem: Users need a way to optimize and edit image files directly within Obsidian without exporting them or using external software.

relations.evidence: This is the Obsidian port of the VS Code extension.

summary: Image manipulation tool that allows users to resize, crop, rotate, compress, and convert image formats within the Obsidian vault.
